prompt_template: Answer with an occupation beginning with {initial}. {definition} is

source.derivation: Fresh paired synonym triads derived from the released occupation domain; source, within-article target, and cross-article target are curated as semantically acceptable realizations of one definition.

class_direction_source: Mean layer-18 target-minus-source residual direction over the six between-class semantic families frozen in correctness_preserving_aan/results/selected_pairs.json.
screening_rule: All three nouns are single-token readouts; each prompt preserves its intended a/an article; the source prompt favors source over each target; each target prompt favors its target over source. No causal outcome enters screening.
primary_estimand: Within-family difference between cross-target and within-target signed public-minus-private target projections at strength 1 and tau 1.
